newsitem.title: USA: Telesensory to offer more shares for less in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Telesensory to offer more shares for less in IPO.

text.p: Telesensory Corp has filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer more shares at a lower price in its initial public offering.
The company filed to offer 2.9 million shares at $11 to $13 a share. Previously it had estimated an IPO of 2.7 million shares priced at $12 to $14.
Jefferies & Co is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is due during the week of October 7.
Telesensory makes braille devices that allow blind people to use personal computers, and the Aladdin family of video magnifiers for people with severely impaired vision.
